title: Hallowed Sepulchre
subtitle: Darkmeyer · timed Agility floors with coffins to loot
facts: [[Drakan's medallion]] to Darkmeyer {have:Drakan's medallion}, or [[Hallowed crystal shard]]s (1 mark each) once marks are spare.

Floor 4 needs 77 Agility and the entry check is boostable: an [[Agility potion]] (+3) {have:Agility potion(4)} or a bite of [[Summer pie]] (+5) {have:Summer pie} at the end of floor 3. Floor 5 (87) and the [[Grand Hallowed Coffin]] are out of reach.
Crossbow + [[Mith grapple]], hammer, saw, planks + nails, [[Vampyre dust]], cosmic runes {have:Mith grapple}
Graceful, [[Holy symbol]] and [[Holy book]] (Saradomin items, so the obelisk at each floor's end refills your run; other god items drain it).

[[Crystal saw]] + hammer, [[Plank sack]] of oak planks + mithril nails, [[Lockpick]] (better coffin success), rune pouch with cosmic + earth + fire, [[Stamina potion]]s, a little food until the hallowed ring. All owned.
~63k looting / ~72k not looting up to floor 3; ~73k / ~81k up to floor 4. Low AFK.

sections.title: How it works
items: Run each floor's trap path on a timer: 2 minutes for floor 1, plus 2 more per floor. Leftover time carries over.
Clear a coffin's obstacle (bridge, brazier, portal, grapple pillar), then loot it for [[Hallowed mark]]s and loot. A failed loot poisons you.
Traps knock you back; time, not HP, is the real cost.
Leave with the obelisk at any floor's end. That's also the only roll for the [[Giant squirrel]].

sections.title: Strategy
items: **Now:** floors 1–3 every run. Don't loot floors 1–2. On floor 3 loot the bridge and portal coffins, skip grapple and brazier.
**Early on:** loot more coffins to build marks for the ring and grapple, and to roll the Mysterious pages (one per floor).
**Floor 4:** about 1¼ hours of floor 3 runs gets you 77 (or boost now). Then floors 1–4, looting everything on floor 4 except the brazier coffin.
Buy a private instance (200 marks) so other players don't throw off the trap timings.

sections.title: Rewards worth it
head: Reward
Marks
Why
rows: Portal coffins (you loot them on floor 3) never fail.
Nails never break on bridge coffins (also looted on floor 3).
No trap damage and faster recovery, so no food.
Grapple shortcuts never fail. Matters once you loot grapple coffins on floor 4.
+1 minute on the timer, and a clog slot.
Brazier coffins use 1 vampyre dust; you skip those, so clog only.
Cosmetic, clog only. The acorn needs the Giant squirrel.
